Subject: Your Google Workspace sync is live, and one decision before Oct 30

Hi Dr. Patel,

I hope you're doing well. The calendar and contacts sync is working now, and your front-desk staff can use it. Before the end of the month there's one thing we need you to decide.

Google now requires a verification review for apps that touch Gmail and Calendar data. If it isn't done by Oct 30, your staff will see an "unverified app" warning and the sync will stop working for new users.

There are two ways to handle it. I'd recommend the free one: your Google Workspace admin can approve the app manually for your own domain. It takes about ten minutes, costs nothing, and covers everyone at Harbor Lane, which is all you need. The other route is Google's formal verification, which costs $540 a year. We can handle the payment and paperwork if you'd rather go that way, but I don't think it buys you anything here.

Sorry this took longer than I'd said it would. If you're open to the manual approval, just reply and I'll send your admin the steps.

Best,
Nate Seluga
